contentHtml:
Are you living in the UAE? Then you must be going through the daily pressures of the rising costs. The expenses of groceries, healthcare, entertainment, and schooling are increasing day by day. These all add up to some extra cost. Many residents and Golden Visa holders feel left out when exclusive offers pop up for locals or employee groups.

That’s where the Fazaa card steps in. This card is a government-backed initiative. It offers huge discounts and perks across many departments. You can get discounts on retail, travel, insurance, healthcare, education, and more.

Fazaa card membership remains exclusive. However, its demand continues to rise among UAE residents and Golden Visa holders. Qualifying for this card can unlock amazing savings throughout the year.

The detailed guide is written to equip you with every detail. Know what a Fazaa card is, its eligibility requirements, how you can obtain one, and the benefits of owning a Fazaa card.

What Is a Fazaa Card and Why Does It Matter?

The Fazaa card is more than a discount card. We can say it is a national social support initiative. The card is managed by the Ministry of Interior’s Social Security Fund. It remains targeted and powerful in improving residents’ quality of life, particularly amid rising costs.

What Is a Fazaa Card?

The Fazaa card began as a solidarity and welfare program. It was introduced under the Ministry of Interior. It offers tiered membership across major sectors. This includes health, travel, retail, groceries, legal services, and events.

Recipients enjoy benefits ranging from discounted care plans to leisure packages. In short, it supports families and working professionals alike.

Fazaa Card Types

The following are some of the types of Fazaa card:

Platinum Card

The platinum card is exclusively for Ministry of Interior employees with the widest benefit range.

Gold Card

This card is for government and semi-government workers. The gold car offers broad benefits.

Silver Card

The silver card is available to semi-government employees and selected private sector staff.

Free/Basic Card

This card offers limited benefits but supports wider inclusion.

Members often review upgrade eligibility via the Fazaa app. They can move to higher tiers where permitted.

Fazaa Card Eligibility Requirements

Among various types of visas in UAE, check which visa type is more suitable to obtain your Fazaa Card. For instance, before expecting to become a Fazaa cardholder, look into the requirements that make you qualify for it. 

Who Is Eligible for the Fazaa Card?

Eligibility stems from formal association with approved entities. You qualify if you fall into one of the groups. To be eligible, you must be a UAE national in government or eligible private sector roles. Employees of the Ministry of Interior or semi-government bodies can obtain a Fazaa Card.

The frontline heroes and people of Determination (Hemam cardholders) are also eligible for it. Plus, registered expatriates working for approved employers are qualified to get the Fazaa Card. In addition, golden visa holders are a new inclusion. It is based on recent policy updates and partnerships.

Common Misconceptions Around Eligibility

Many assume all residents can apply. That’s not the case. The eligibility criteria depend on the company or body registration. To initiate applications, employers or organizations need to register and share a company code. Card availability and tiers depend on your employer’s Fazaa registration.

How to Get the Fazaa Card: Application Process Explained

The application process to apply for your Fazaa Card is simple. All you need to do is follow the steps below. Don’t skip any step so that you can make a seamless move towards obtaining your Fazaa Card.

Step-by-Step Application Process

Once you confirm eligibility, follow these steps:

  • Visit the official Fazaa website or download the app.
  • Enter your employer’s company code.
  • Fill personal/employment details (name, Emirates ID, contact info).
  • Verify via SMS OTP.
  • Upload the necessary documents, including Emirates ID, passport, and employment proof.
  • Submit and wait for the approval. It will take a few days.
  • Lastly, download the Fazaa app and log in by using the UAE Pass or credentials.

Fazaa Card for Hemam Members (People of Determination)

The application process is a little different for Hemam members. Apply via the Zayed Higher Organisation. You can also apply through the Ministry of Community Development portal.

To apply, submit your Emirates ID. Plus, a passport, a personal photo, a medical report, and a valid visa are also required. Receive Fazaa membership via SMS for digital access.

Fazaa Card Benefits for UAE Residents & Golden Visa Holders

The Fazaa card benefits cover a wide range of sectors. The card transforms daily living into a more affordable experience. We have discussed some of the Fazaa card benefits for golden visa UAE holders.

Top Benefits of the Fazaa Card

The following are the top benefits of a Fazaa card

  • Healthcare & Medical Services: Get discounts at select clinics, hospitals, and pharmacies.
  • Travel & Tourism: Receive special rates on flights, hotel bookings, and vacation packages.
  • Automotive & Insurance: Make savings on car rentals, insurance premiums, and upkeep.
  • Dining, Retail & Groceries: Avail offers in supermarkets, cafes, malls, and restaurants.
  • Education & Childcare: Experience reductions on tuition, nursery fees, and bookstore purchases.
  • Fitness, Beauty & Lifestyle: Enjoy deals at gyms, wellness centers, and spas.
  • Legal & Real Estate: Obtain budget consultancy and property-related services.

Unique Offers for Golden Visa Holders

Golden Visa holders gain access to premium offers. They can get priority customer service and invitations to time-limited events. These events often include designated areas where Fazaa cards can be issued to Golden Visa holders.

These events coincide with large public programs or fairs. You can take advantage of the UAE golden visa benefits when offered through Fazaa.

Fazaa Card Renewal and Upgrade Options

Keeping your Fazaa card active. Explore higher tiers that ensure ongoing access to perks.

How to Renew a Fazaa Card

  • Log in to the Fazaa app or online portal.
  • Access the renewal section and update your employment details.
  • Submit the renewal request and wait for confirmation.

Upgrading to Silver, Gold, or Platinum

Check upgrade eligibility via the app. Select the desired tier. Then, follow the payment process if applicable. Note that some employment categories restrict upgrade options to particular tiers.

Common Issues and User Concerns

Despite its advantages, users often encounter issues during application or usage.

Frequent User Pain Points

Below are the major pain points that users often face with a Fazaa Card:

  • The eligibility confusion arises when many try to apply without going through employer channels.
  • If the employer is not registered with Fazaa or has an invalid company code. It also leads to a delay.
  • Lack of English-language support in the application or documentation also creates a roadblock.
  • No timely notifications when eligibility changes or new offers launch are another issue.
  • Missed event alerts offering free or discounted card issuance also sometimes bring problems.

Final Thoughts: Is the Fazaa Card Worth It?

If you qualify, the Fazaa card UAE offers real value. It offsets recurring costs like travel, education, and healthcare. The offers tailored to Golden Visa holders and government employees deliver higher value. The convenient app-based management makes renewal and upgrades simple.

And with the Royal visa recently introduced for investors and contributors, Fazaa cardholders, particularly senior visa holders, can add yet another layer of exclusive perks. For further assistance, explore resources with UAE visa consultants to make the most of Fazaa membership.

FAQs Section

Who Can Get a Fazaa Card in The UAE?

Only employees of the Ministry of Interior, government/semi-government entities, frontline workers, People of Determination, and select private sector nationals or expats qualify.

Is the Fazaa Card Available for Expats?

Yes! Expatriates can apply only if their employer is registered and they receive a valid company code. General expats cannot self-apply.

How to Apply for A Fazaa Card?

Visit the Fazaa site or app, enter the company code, complete your profile, upload documents, verify via SMS OTP, and submit. After approval, download the app to access your card.

Can I Upgrade or Renew My Fazaa Card Through the App?

Yes! The app allows you to renew your card annually and upgrade your membership (e.g., Silver to Gold) depending on eligibility.
